<MethodEndpoint

Requires `maintainer`, not `developer`, because the dev agents' git actions inherit the role of WHOEVER ACTIVATED it in the IAM evaluation — activating as developer would leave agents unable to open a PR. Each module in the `module_map` gets an agent in an isolated worktree.
